case.component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
case.narrative: While at a red light, my car was stopped with Tesla Full Self-Driving (FSD) on. When the car in front of me nudged forward, my car, still in FSD , accelerated and drove into the car in front. Looking at the event report of my car, the automatic emergency break did engage but too late. This means the sensors in front failed to recognize the vehicle ahead.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
